tools.name: pkg_check
tools.description: Is this package safe to install? Input: name, ecosystem (npm | PyPI), optional version

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_url · Public sink: summarize, translate, extract, extract_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_url · Public sink: summarize, translate, extract, extract_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
